title: Windmill-shaped octanuclear ZnII4/LnIII4 (LnIII = Dy, Tb, Ho) heterometallic ensembles supported by a tetraferrocene scaffold

material_class.structural_family: windmill-shaped octanuclear Zn4Ln4 cluster on a tetraferrocene scaffold

synthesis.procedure: A general procedure was used for 2–4. H4L (1) was dissolved in 30 mL CHCl3/MeOH (1:1 v/v) and triethylamine was added. Dy(NO3)3·H2O was added and the mixture was stirred for 30 min, giving an orange-red precipitate. Zn(OAc)2·2H2O was then added and the mixture was refluxed for 8 h to a clear solution, filtered, and vacuum-dried to an orange solid. The solid was washed with diethyl ether (10 mL), dried, and dissolved in CHCl3/CH3CN (1:1 v/v). Slow evaporation at room temperature for 2–4 days afforded X-ray-quality crystals of 2. Quantities for 2: Zn(OAc)2·2H2O (41.0 mg, 0.187 mmol), Dy(NO3)3·H2O (71.0 mg, 0.188 mmol), H4L (100.0 mg, 0.186 mmol).
synthesis.temperature: reflux (8 h); crystallization at room temperature
synthesis.time: 30 min stirring after Ln addition; 8 h reflux; 2–4 days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reflux followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered and vacuum-dried; washed with 10 mL diethyl ether; redissolved in CHCl3/CH3CN (1:1 v/v); slow evaporation at RT for 2–4 days

properties.summary: χMT of 2 at 300 K is 55.0 cm3 mol−1 K (expected 56.6 for four DyIII), decreasing to 28.0 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K. Magnetization at 2 K rises rapidly at low field without saturation. No significant antiferromagnetic Ln···Ln coupling; no out-of-phase AC signal even under a static field (no slow magnetic relaxation).

measurements.name: AC susceptibility χM''
measurements.conditions: AC field 3 Oe, 1–1500 Hz; with and without applied DC field
